subject: Difficulties when trying to plot relative frequencies

messages.author: 2401d0740178cf07
messages.subject: Difficulties when trying to plot relative frequencies
parts:
Dear list,

I am trying to plot relative frequencies and I cannot find the way to make such a plot. Please see the code I am using:

library(ggplot2)
df<-read.table(header=T, text=
'class year value
1 1996  2899
2 1996   213
3 1996   544
4 1996    45
6 1996   256
7 1996    10
1 1997  2787
2 1997   203
3 1997   542
4 1997    47
6 1997   255
7 1997    10
1 1998  2751
2 1998   202
3 1998   542
4 1998    45
6 1998   256
7 1998     9
1 1999  2746
2 1999   202
3 1999   542
4 1999    44
6 1999   257
7 1999     7
1 2000  2737
2 2000   200
3 2000   542
4 2000    44
6 2000   258
7 2000     9')

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=year, y=value, group=class))
p + geom_line(aes(colour = as.factor(class))) +
    scale_colour_discrete(name = "Classes") +      #
   theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()) +  # remove graph grids

    labs(x= 'Year', y='Count')                                       # change axis names

The graph is *almost* what I pursue. However, instead of "count" on the y axis, I would like to show relative frequencies. By "relative frequencies" I mean the proportion of each class relative to the total of that year. For example, class 1 (2899) represents 0.73 of 3967 total values in 1996.

Any ideas to adjust the code in order to achieve that?

Many thanks in advance,
Thiago.

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Difficulties when trying to plot relative frequencies
parts:
I would just calculate the values using plyr and then plot them:

library(plyr)
df <- ddply(df,
"year",
transform,
prop = value/sum(value))


ggplot(df, aes(x=year, y=prop, group=class)) +

geom_line(aes(colour = as.factor(class))) +
scale_colour_discrete(name = "Classes") + #
theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()) + # remove graph grids
labs(x= 'Year', y='Count')
